I

两种 scenarioTwo scenarios

Multicritical

真实的 unitary fixed point，有 两个 relevant 方向：t 与 s。格点扫描只调掉 t，残余的 s 让 RG flow 离开 → weakly first orderA real unitary fixed point with two relevant directions, t and s. The lattice scan tunes t only; the residual s drives the flow away → weakly first order

Complex-CFT walking

fixed points 离开实轴，RG flow 缓慢 walking；walking 方向近乎 marginal，Δs ≈ 3Fixed points leave the real axis; the flow walks slowly; the walking direction is nearly marginal, Δs ≈ 3
I

两个判据Two diagnostics

DQCP 对应的是 complex fixed points，还是 unitary multicritical fixed point？Is the DQCP related to complex fixed points, or to a unitary multicritical fixed point?

① singlet 是否明显 relevant① Is the singlet clearly relevant?

walking 要求 Δs ≈ 3。
Δs 明显小于 3 → 实的 multicritical fixed pointWalking wants Δs ≈ 3.
Δs well below 3 → a real multicritical fixed point

② 是否存在 unitary 的 operator algebra② Is there a unitary operator algebra?

spectrum + OPE 能否同时满足 crossing symmetry 与 reflection positivity：这正是 bootstrap 能回答的Do spectrum + OPE satisfy crossing and reflection positivity together: exactly what the bootstrap answers
策略：Strategy: 用少数 QMC 维度 定位 bootstrap 解，再用 不参与定位 的 higher spectrum 与 OPE 来检验它use a few QMC dimensions to locate the bootstrap solution, then test it with higher spectra and OPEs not used to locate it

Fuzzy sphere：把 CFT 放到 S² × ℝ 上Fuzzy sphere: the CFT on S² × ℝ

  • lowest Landau level，N 个 orbitals，四味 fermion 半满Lowest Landau level, N orbitals, four fermion flavors at half filling
  • SO(5) 对称哈密顿量，g = V/USO(5)-symmetric Hamiltonian, g = V/U

只用两个点标定Calibrated by two points only

Δ = 2(E − E0)/(EJ − E0)  ⇒  ΔJ = 2
每个 N 调 g 使 ΔT = 3 → g*(N)。其余所有能量与矩阵元都是预言。At each N tune g so that ΔT = 3 → g*(N). All other energies and matrix elements are predictions.
先例：Precedent: fuzzy sphere 已对 3D Ising 给出与 bootstrap 高度一致的 spectrum 与 OPE（Zhu–Han–Huffman–Hofmann–He 2023；Hu–He–Zhu 2023）。DQCP 是它在 gauge theory 上的应用。For 3D Ising the fuzzy sphere reproduced bootstrap spectra and OPEs closely (Zhu–Han–Huffman–Hofmann–He 2023; Hu–He–Zhu 2023). The DQCP applies it to a gauge theory.
IV

两项技术改进Two technical improvements

① Symmetry projection

按 ℓ 与 SU(2)A×SU(2)B ⊂ Spin(5) 分块，再分辨 exchange 本征值、Casimir 与 parity：精确约化，到达 N = 12Block by ℓ and SU(2)A×SU(2)B ⊂ Spin(5), then exchange eigenvalue, Casimir and parity: an exact reduction reaching N = 12

② Conformal lowering

primary 满足 Kμ|𝒪⟩ = 0。由 energy density 构造 Kμ，A primary obeys Kμ|𝒪⟩ = 0. Build Kμ from the energy density,
QK = Σμ Kμ†Kμ
投影权重 wP ≥ 0.90 判为 primaryprojection weight wP ≥ 0.90 → primary
分类 不使用任何 bootstrap 信息，因此与 bootstrap 谱的吻合是独立检验。The classification uses no bootstrap input, so agreement with the bootstrap spectrum is an independent test.

  • relevant singlet 指出了通往相邻相（如 spin liquid）的方向The relevant singlet points toward neighboring phases (e.g. spin liquids)

可检验的预言Testable predictions

  • QMC 中加一个 SO(5) 保持的相互作用并重新调参：scaling window 的长度应随之改变QMC: add an SO(5)-preserving interaction and retune; the scaling window should change accordingly
  • long-range DQCP：sign-free 的验证途径Long-range DQCP: a sign-free route
  • SrCu₂(BO₃)₂：压力与磁场双调参SrCu₂(BO₃)₂: double tuning of pressure and field
VI

下一步：从 cone 到 island，再到更深的物理Next: from cone to island, and deeper physics

① Conserved-current bootstrap① Conserved-current bootstrap

把 Jμ 与 Tμν 作为 external operators，Ward identity 联系 CJ、CT，解锁新的 OPE 结构与更多谱Jμ and Tμν as external operators; Ward identities tie in CJ, CT and unlock new OPE structures and spectra

② 把 cone 变成 island② Turn the cone into an island

locality 与更合适的 spectral assumptions：剔除连接大陆的局域理论，得到 DQCP 的精确 CFT dataLocality and sharper spectral assumptions remove the local theories linking to the continent → precise DQCP CFT data

③ 更高 Λ 与 gap 结构③ Higher Λ and gap structure

哪些 gap 让 cone 变尖、哪些新算符出现，本身就是关于这个 CFT 的物理信息Which gaps sharpen the cone and which operators appear is physical information about this CFT
bootstrap 的 spectrum 与 OPE 是给 fuzzy sphere、QMC 和材料的 定量预言。Bootstrap spectra and OPEs are quantitative predictions for the fuzzy sphere, QMC and materials.
Summary

总结Summary

Bootstrap

sharp cone，apex 紧贴 QMC；φ–s–t mixing 给出 9 个 irreps 的谱与 OPE；Δs = 2.258A sharp cone next to QMC; φ–s–t mixing supplies spectra and OPEs in 9 irreps; Δs = 2.258

Fuzzy sphere

symmetry projection 到 N = 12；conformal lowering 识别出 52 个 primaries，其中 31 个此前未被识别Symmetry projection to N = 12; conformal lowering identifies 52 primaries, 31 of them new

合起来Together

spectrum、OPE 与 QMC 指数一致 → unitary SO(5) multicritical CFTSpectra, OPEs and QMC exponents agree → a unitary SO(5) multicritical CFT
从“几个临界指数是否吻合”，走向“整套 operator algebra 是否一致”。From “do a few exponents agree” to “is the whole operator algebra consistent”.

规则文件与修稿流程Rules file and revision loop

经验：AI 擅长与易错之处Lessons: strengths and failure modes

擅长Good at

  • 大块工程：symmetry-blocked ED、作业流水线Large engineering: symmetry-blocked ED, job pipelines
  • 重复性核查与重算Repetitive checks and recomputation
  • 图、表、正文、数据保持一致Keeping figures, tables, text and data consistent

易错Failure modes

  • OPE 归一化约定（λ、λiso、β）OPE normalization conventions (λ, λiso, β)
  • 倾向改写已打磨的文字Tendency to rewrite polished prose
  • 混用不同版本或不同 N 的数据Mixing data across versions or sizes
  • 自我确认 → 用盲 sessionSelf-confirmation → blind sessions
